task: Predict teacher motion action 1/2/3 before first positive target visibility proxy, use only strong out-of-frustum negatives at these times. Exclude SAFE/STOP. Right-censored episodes identified separately.
sampling: train uniformly over distinct scene-route and then rows; replacement, same pregenerated index batches. Duplicate native paraphrases must not supply additional process clusters. Dev score each distinct route cluster, aggregate weighted by image windows, supplementary on future proxy-acquired routes.
frozen_vision: R2 original pre-FiLM third conv of previous/current frames, fixed strip-pooled features and unit L2 normalization; identical route preprocessing. Model was selected on known dev geometries, diagnostic only.
frozen_text: Frozen BERT-base uncased masked mean final features for supplied natural language, L2 normalized. Zero input is exactly zero feature. Test swap = first lexically sorted different target from same scene, offline original teacher label under perturbation, not counterfactual ground truth. Original R2 and pretrained BERT not retrained.
fusion: concatenate R2 features, frozen text, previous executed action one hot; tanh hidden 48 and 3-class linear; AdamW, lr=.001, wd=.0001, 250 x64 fixed updates, seed 20261117. Correct vs zero language fits identical initialization and schedule. No checkpoint selection.
gate: Positive diagnostic requires correct language higher dev macro F1 than matched blank fit + correct-fit swapped and empty. Also report paired route cluster bootstrap 95% CI (2000, seed fixed), per-route and subset. No closed-loop promotion on nonpositive or statistically unresolved results.
